page.title: Projects
page.purpose: Find, create and safely reopen local presentation projects with their latest saved work and unresolved tasks.

priorities.statement: Find the project and its latest useful output.
Start a local project without an account or provider call.
Understand recovery and missing inputs before opening a project.

states.description: No operation is pending; identify the current task and available next action.
Work is acknowledged and queued or in flight with observed progress or an honest indeterminate state.
A safe retry is actively reconciling or executing without blind duplicate side effects.
Explain the current task, saved revision and next meaningful action.
Name what is loading; retain stable layout and existing local content.
Acknowledge the requested operation once and prevent duplicate costly submissions.
Distinguish local draft changes from durably saved revision; never claim saved early.
Explain local versus remote state and conflict resolution without silently overwriting edits.
Retain usable content and identify the specific information being refreshed.
Explain why there is no content and offer a relevant low-risk first action.
Show which inputs, output or services are available and which remain incomplete.
Show age, affected decisions and explicit refresh; never silently spend on refresh.
Confirm the concrete durable result and offer inspection or the next task.
Associate actionable correction with each invalid field while preserving input.
Explain the failed operation, preserved work and safe next action with diagnostic reference.
Identify the unavailable operation and authority boundary without requesting unrelated access.
Keep supported local work usable; mark online operations unavailable and never auto-submit paid work on reconnect.
Explain whether retry reuses an operation identity, reconciles prior work or starts a newly authorized operation.
An interrupted draft offers inspect/recover/discard; no automatic remote execution.
Validate archive limits, paths and versions before extraction into a managed workspace.
Offer local relink by hash/path with preview and no automatic upload.

claims.statement: Project entry preserves the last durable shot revision and distinguishes recoverable draft work.
claims.rationale: Unimplemented design intent; runtime bindings, exact state setup, visual evidence and operator review remain required.

claims.statement: Creating, searching and opening local projects require no cloud sign-in, credits or hidden AI call.
claims.rationale: Unimplemented design intent; runtime bindings, exact state setup, visual evidence and operator review remain required.

x-design.layout: Searchable recent-project rows with meaningful thumbnails, save/recovery badges and one Create project action; compact list alternative. Mobile preserves search and recovery actions.
controls: Create project naming and workspace location; no AI call
Open or import portable project archive with bounded inspection
Search/filter/sort by recent edit, name, status; accessible list/grid switch
Rename, duplicate, archive and delete with affected-media explanation and recoverability policy
details: Thumbnail absence is a neutral placeholder, not fabricated success.
Import shows version, required media, missing files, unsupported features and secret stripping before adoption.
Local file-picker cancellation leaves current project untouched.

x-evidence-policy: No fake selectors, region bindings, setup hooks, captures or attestations. Planned controls are metadata until implemented and grounded.

x-implementation.stage: E1 workspace; final scoped unit pending
implemented: Honest empty and no-saved-shot preview states
x-implementation.limits: Existing aspirational shot, recovery, privacy, budget, archive and search claims remain unimplemented. E2 media UI is in progress. No release or whole-page claim is promoted by this annotation.
